I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to VirusTotal’s API or the ability to retrieve CAA records for instagram.com. However, you can use the following command line snippet to fetch the CAA records via `dig`:

```bash
dig +short instagram.com CAA
```

If you want to query VirusTotal programmatically, you’ll need to use their official API. Here’s an example using Python:

```python
import requests

api_key = "ig_key001"
url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/instagram.com"

headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key,
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
```

This will return the domain information, including DNS records. If you’re specifically looking for CAA records, you might need to parse the response or use a dedicated DNS lookup service.
